requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop NGB keyed bottles with a page yield of 6,000 for Black and 6,000 for CMY. The CMY bottle size must support yields greater than 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: High-yield bottles reduce user intervention, support high-volume use cases, and are necessary to meet market and warranty goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new tank design and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are available and certified for 6,000 Black, 6,000 CMY, and >8,000 CMY yields in field testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottle Refilling
requirements.Description: Ensure the bottle refilling process is spill-free to prevent ink leakage during user operation.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience, reduces mess, and decreases support costs due to ink spills.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank interface design, IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field tests show <1% incident rate of ink spills during refilling across 1,000 cycles.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label into the NOA-F component, with no changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and security of the ink system, while maintaining user familiarity and existing processes.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label pass all reliability and usability tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost, leverages proven technology, and accelerates time to market.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility verification with new tank and IDS systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks pass compatibility and reliability tests with new system.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modelling
requirements.Description: Perform reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS characterization and modelling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL) scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system durability, print quality, and performance throughout product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Finalized hardware design and IDS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive reliability and characterization reports completed and reviewed.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling for Tank Impact
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Stable ink ensures consistent print quality and reduces maintenance issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model shows no significant PQ degradation over projected product life.

requirements.Title: Support for Service Parts in Warranty
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as a service part to support warranty claims and replacements.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer satisfaction and compliance with warranty obligations.
requirements.Stakeholders: Customer Support, Service Centers, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is included in service parts catalog and available for warranty replacements.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology into the lid component.
requirements.Rationale: May relate to authentication, tracking, or enhanced user interaction (pending clarification).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Lid with Acumen 6 passes all functional and security tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Supports manufacturing of new components and ensures efficient production.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 and Orcus 5 lines successfully produce NOA-F and Magi ink components at required volume.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the platform to allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components without service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and enhances customer experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customer can replace PHA and NOA-F in under 10 minutes using provided instructions.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure the platform supports a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations for durability and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Quality Assurance, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform demonstrates 80,000-page life in accelerated lifecycle tests.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Offering
requirements.Description: Develop a SKU 2 product offering with high throughput and PDL support as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) model.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses business model flexibility and new market segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for order and PaaS subscriptions.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID design with an increased tank size. No changes to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and aligns with industrial design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes ID review and tank capacity tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for packaging to protect the product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage in transit and supports sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration tests with no product damage.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Requirements
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and efficiency standards for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Compliance with regulatory and eco-label requirements enhances marketability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with increased tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility and efficient paper handling with new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays accommodate tank protrusion and pass paper handling tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (color graphical display) into the user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interaction and supports advanced functions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD operational in all product configurations.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage a four-tube platform using Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances ink delivery reliability and supports new tank configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four-tube system passes flow and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station with spit platform changes due to new tank.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels within safe limits in service station tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures printhead performance and reliability with new hardware configuration.
requirements.Dependencies: Carriage design, tube and tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage system passes dynamic and force compliance tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Upgrade for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Upgrade the paper path to support the increased page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents wear and maintains reliability over extended product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes accelerated life testing for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Serviceable Ink Maintenance Part
requirements.Description: Design the ink maintenance component as a serviceable part, replaceable at a service center post-80k life.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates maintenance and extends product usability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced in service center within 30 minutes.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (fluidic interface) connections for IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and prevents incorrect installation.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS and tank design, connector sourcing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS connections pass reliability and usability testing.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to ensure optimal ink flow and startup performance.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces startup failures and print defects.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate >99% in validation tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definitions
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion criteria to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and supports new warranty and yield targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion definitions documented and validated in testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for the platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components pass integration and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module into the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Provides wireless connectivity for modern office and home environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity and performance tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Use Dune firmware for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Standardizes firmware and leverages existing software assets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune firmware operates reliably on Magellan hardware.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security and protects against threats.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass penetration and compliance tests.

requirements.Title: Speed of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Ensure print speed of 25 ppm for standard and 20 ppm for color; PDL variants must achieve 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for productivity and throughput.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print speed validated in benchmark tests for all variants.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All business model paths are supported and documented.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Provide SMB manageability features and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Meets needs of business customers for device management and integration.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB and Enterprise Customers, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Manageability features available and functional in enterprise environments.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers for seamless installation and operation.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and easy deployment across environments.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers pass installation and functional tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence for S’27 Launch
requirements.Description: Meet the scheduled checkpoints and milestones for S’27 launch as outlined in the program timeline.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for time-to-market and business objectives.
requirements.Dependencies: All deliverables and dependencies on critical path.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints met per program schedule without major delays.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constraint)
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a minimum operational life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures component reliability and aligns with product goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing for 65,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years
requirements.Description: Platform must support a warranty life of 2 years for all major components.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market norms and customer expectations.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Quality Assurance, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty claims are within acceptable limits over 2-year period in field trials.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure the maintenance box is easily serviceable for end users or service technicians.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and cost of ownership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in under 15 minutes with minimal tools.
